column1: # Error-mapping coverage config — one row per consolidated ratchet.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Only the genuinely-uniform clones live here. Bespoke/multi-enum rails
# scripts/check/<group>/ rail. The `rust` rows retired in Arc 2 WP-B1: the
# per-transport `*_error_to_code` converters they covered were deleted when
# the C binding moved onto `tst_pipeline::binding::BindingError`, whose
# py rows:    lang  name  class           make_fn                              (col5 unused)
# pyarm rows: lang  name  enum            variant_source                       py_file  [match_names]
#             (every <enum> variant in variant_source needs an explicit
#              py_file — a Python-binding .rs source, not the C ABI;
#              match_names may be an alternation like "KlvEncodeError|RustE"
#              for a mapper that locally aliases the enum)
